bitbucket_username: your Atlassian account email (with an API token) or Bitbucket username
bitbucket_app_password: the API token or app password
bitbucket_token: OR a workspace/repository access token -- leave the two above empty if used
postgres_password: any strong random value, e.g. from: openssl rand -hex 24
ecr_pull_access_key_id: AKIA... of the pull-only IAM user
kubeconfig_b64: OPTIONAL: base64 of a kubeconfig limited to the fleet-dev namespace; omit if the runner uses its own service account
